None are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/, and the changed symbols carry no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR). The AlertList.vue change restores the 'Check every'/frequency column with cron vs interval vs real-time rendering, AlertEvaluationHistory.vue adds a retries column, and AlertSectionTabs.vue renames tab labels to match the nav rail — all user-exercisable alerting UI flows that need verifying in a real browser.
